lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: I spent a year down here, once. Before the mists, before any of this. You don't forget the sound the crevasses make at night — like the whole mountain's still settling into the hole they cut for it.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Not much worth saying that isn't scars. What matters is I got out, and I'm not planning on either of us staying long this time. Watch the ledges — the spikes hold, but the rock around them doesn't always.
